priority_boundary: The labelled minimum counts of ordinary Roman functions on cycles, equivalent to the global counts for n>=6, are already Theorem 2.4(ii)-(iv) of Deepak G., Alwardi and Indiramma (2021). The claim here is limited to the complete dihedral/gap classification and complement-feasibility comparison.
scientific_limitations: Unindexed earlier equivalent orbit classifications remain possible; no formal expert certification or higher-weight/general-graph result is claimed.
scientific_scope: Every simple cycle of order n>=3, minimum-weight simultaneous cycle/complement Roman labelings, cyclic gap forms and dihedral symmetry orbit counts.
title: Dihedral classification of minimum global Roman functions on cycles
